purpose: Define privacy-aware longitudinal learning and event-driven reanalysis after accepted baselines exist.
privacy_rule: Prefer anonymous/aggregate environmental, maintenance and operational evidence; personal/biometric data requires justified purpose, governance, minimisation and consent where applicable.
learning_rule: Positive, neutral, negative and failed findings remain in the evidence record; no cherry-picking.
timing_rule: P30/P90/P365 are optional internal learning checkpoints only; event-driven reanalysis is primary and no statutory interval is inferred.
promotion_rule: Observed trends do not automatically become design changes; relevant owner/discipline acceptance and rollback remain required.
biofield_boundary: Biofield remains a project R&D label; operational promotion requires reproducible measured outcomes without therapeutic/clinical claims.
